Médecin de Cos. Il cherche les causes de: Physician from Kos. He sought the causes of disease in nature, not in the gods.
Médecin chinois de la fin des Han. On lu: Chinese physician of the late Han. A herbal anaesthetic, mafeisan, is attributed to him.
Anatomiste de Bruxelles. Sa Fabrica (154: Anatomist from Brussels. His Fabrica (1543) showed the body as dissection reveals it.
Médecin anglais. En 1628, il montre que: English physician. In 1628 he showed that the heart pumps the blood round in a loop.
Naturaliste suédois. Il nomme chaque esp: Swedish naturalist. He named every species with two Latin words.
Médecin de campagne anglais. En 1796, il: English country doctor. In 1796 he protected a boy from smallpox with cowpox.
Médecin allemand. Il identifie le bacill: German physician. He identified the tuberculosis bacillus in 1882.
Médecin de Damas et du Caire. Il décrit: Physician of Damascus and Cairo. He described the passage of blood through the lungs.
Prêtre et naturaliste italien. Ses bouil: Italian priest and naturalist. No microbes appeared in his sealed broths.
Biologiste américaine. Les mitochondries: American biologist. Mitochondria, she argued, are bacteria swallowed long ago.
Drapier néerlandais devenu savant. Avec: Dutch draper turned scientist. With microscopes he made himself, he was the first to see microorganisms.
Médecin et poète italien. En 1668, il mo: Italian physician and poet. In 1668, he showed that maggots do not arise from rotting meat: they appear only if flies could lay their eggs on it.
